combo_label: Breakfast × Puppets & Punch and Judy × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Brand of palm-sized wholewheat biscuit that slumps to sludge in the bowl
Carved from lime or pine, as a marionette's head and limbs traditionally are
Smaller inner pillar of Welsh rock, named for the tint it shows when wet
Toy in human shape; unlike a puppet, nothing inside it is being worked
Threads running from the control bar down to a marionette's head, arms and knees
Enamel-capped biters whose chemistry betrays where their owner grew up
What the Scots boil into porridge, flattened into flakes by a roller
Of the last age of polished flint and farming, before metal arrived
Deep round cooking vessel with one long handle, brought to the boil on a ring
